Microstructure, shape memory properties, and in vitro biocompatibility of porous NiTi scaffolds fabricated via selective laser melting

High AM Biomedical Materials openalex Direct Read now mechanical_testing Exp. validation
H.Z. Lu, Hongwei Ma, Xuan Luo, Yan Wang, Jialin Wang et al. Journal of Materials Research and Technology 2021-11-01 10.1016/j.jmrt.2021.11.112
单位: National Engineering Research Center of Near-net-shape Forming for Metallic Materials, Guangdong Provincial Key Laboratory for Processing and Forming of Advanced Metallic Materials, South China Univer
通讯: Shuo Yin @ Trinity College Dublin, The University of Dublin, Department of Mechanical, Manufacturing and Biomedical Engineering, Du  |  Chao Yang @ National Engineering Research Center of Near-net-shape Forming for Metallic Materials, Guangdong Provincial Key Laborato
相关性: 该论文直接研究了通过SLM制备的多孔NiTi支架，其弹性模量与人体骨接近，可能缓解应力遮挡问题，且包含力学测试和生物相容性评价。
边界: Does not include fatigue testing, surface roughness quantification, or osseointegration in vivo. The mechanical testing is only quasi-static compression, not cyclic loading.
动机· 制备与人体骨弹性模量匹配的多孔NiTi支架，缓解应力遮挡。
方法· 采用SLM制备三种孔径的多孔NiTi，系统表征微观结构、力学、形状记忆及细胞相容性。
结果· 支架弹性模量接近人骨，压缩强度优于多数报道，900μm孔径支架可恢复应变5.10%。
验证· 通过SEM、micro-CT、DSC、压缩测试和体外细胞培养验证。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To fabricate porous NiTi scaffolds with elastic modulus matching human bone to mitigate stress shielding in bone implants.
Method· Three porous NiTi scaffolds with different pore sizes were fabricated via selective laser melting, and systematically characterized for microstructure, mechanical properties, shape memory, and in vitro biocompatibility.
Result· The scaffolds exhibited elastic modulus close to human bone, compressive strength superior to reported porous NiTi alloys, and a maximum recoverable strain of 5.10% for the 900 μm pore size scaffold.
Validation· Validation included scanning electron microscopy, micro-computed tomography, differential scanning calorimetry, compressive testing, and in vitro cell culture experiments.

In silico and in vivo studies of the effect of surface curvature on the osteoconduction of porous scaffolds

High AM Biomedical Materials openalex Direct Read now animal Exp. validation
Yun Zhang, Peng Wang, Jiyong Jin, Lan Li, Siyuan He et al. Biotechnology and Bioengineering 2021-11-01 10.1002/bit.27976
单位: State Key Laboratory of Bioelectronics, School of Biological Science and Medical Engineering Southeast University Nanjing China
通讯: Siyuan He @ State Key Laboratory of Bioelectronics, School of Biological Science and Medical Engineering Southeast University Nanji  |  Qing Jiang @ Department of Sports Medicine and Adult Reconstructive Surgery, State Key Laboratory of Pharmaceutical Biotechnology, Na
相关性: 该论文直接研究多孔支架表面曲率对骨传导的影响，涉及LPBF制造、力学性能及体内验证，与AM生物医学方向高度相关。
边界: This paper does not report fatigue testing, stress shielding quantification, or surface roughness/as-built morphology characterization.
动机· 探究多孔支架表面曲率引导骨再生的机制
方法· 建立数学模型模拟曲率效应，并用SLM制造钛支架进行兔体内验证
结果· 高曲率区域促进生长因子分布和骨沉积，模型预测与体内结果一致
验证· 兔股骨髁体内植入实验验证数学模型
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To elucidate the mechanism by which surface curvature of porous scaffolds guides osteoconduction for enhanced bone regeneration.
Method· An in silico model incorporating key aspects of bone regeneration was developed, and selective laser melting was used to fabricate titanium scaffolds with varying strut curvatures for in vivo validation in rabbit femur condyles.
Result· Simulations showed that higher curvature promoted growth factor distribution and osteoblast migration, leading to bone deposition at high-curvature locations, consistent with in vivo observations.
Validation· In vivo implantation in rabbit femur condyles confirmed the model predictions of curvature-guided bone formation.

Three-dimensional-printed individualized porous implants: A new "implant-bone" interface fusion concept for large bone defect treatment.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Direct Save for project clinical Exp. validation Patient-specific
Teng Zhang, Qingguang Wei, Hua Zhou, Zehao Jing, Xiaoguang Liu et al. Bioactive materials 2021-11-01 10.1016/j.bioactmat.2021.03.030
单位: Department of Orthopedics, Peking University Third Hospital, Beijing, 100191, People's Republic of China.
通讯: Zhongjun Liu @ Department of Orthopedics, Peking University Third Hospital, Beijing, 100191, People's Republic of China. [推断]
相关性: 该论文直接采用3D打印多孔植入物修复大段骨缺损，结合临床和动物实验验证骨整合与生物力学稳定性，与您的AM生物医用材料方向高度相关。
边界: Does not include LPBF-specific fabrication details, fatigue testing, or as-built surface roughness characterization.
动机· 探索无需骨移植的3D打印多孔植入物治疗大段骨缺损的方法。
方法· 设计并植入个性化多孔钛合金植入物至患者和羊股骨缺损模型。
结果· 植入物与宿主骨实现长期稳定的骨整合和力学支撑。
验证· 通过26例临床病例和羊大段股骨缺损模型验证效果。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To develop a simple technique using 3D-printed porous implants without bone grafts for treating large bone defects.
Method· Individualized porous implants were fabricated and implanted in 26 patients and a sheep segmental femur defect model.
Result· Long-term biomechanical stability and osseointegration were achieved, with bone ingrowth and remodeling observed.
Validation· Clinical follow-up of patients and histological analysis of sheep explants confirmed osseointegration and mechanical stability.

The effect of a novel pillar surface morphology and material composition demonstrates uniform osseointegration.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials pubmed Peripheral Background only animal Exp. validation
Gregory C Causey, George J Picha, Jamey Price, Matthew H Pelletier, Tian Wang et al. Journal of the mechanical behavior of biomedical materials 2021-11-01 10.1016/j.jmbbm.2021.104775
单位: Applied Medical Technology, Brecksville, OH, USA. Electronic address: greg.causey@appliedmedical.net.
通讯: Gregory C Causey @ Applied Medical Technology, Brecksville, OH, USA. Electronic address: greg.causey@appliedmedical.net.
相关性: 该论文涉及骨整合表面形态的体内验证，但未涉及AM制造、疲劳或应力遮挡问题，与用户方向关联有限。
边界: This paper does not involve LPBF fabrication, fatigue testing, or stress shielding analysis; it focuses on in-vivo osseointegration of a specific pillar geometry without relating to implant stiffness matching.
动机· 探索新型柱状表面形态对骨整合的影响，减少对材料的依赖。
方法· 在羊模型中植入不同材料的柱状表面种植体，进行μCT和组织学分析。
结果· 所有材料在12周时均显示高骨整合，皮质部位骨长入达80%。
验证· 通过动物实验、组织学和推出测试验证机械性能。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate whether a macro-scale pillar surface morphology can achieve uniform osseointegration regardless of implant material composition.
Method· In-vivo ovine model with implants of various materials (PEEK, PEEK HA, Ti-coated PEEK, Ti-6Al-4V, UHMWPE) all having identical pillar surface geometry, evaluated via μCT, histology, histomorphometry, and pushout testing at 6 and 12 weeks.
Result· All materials exhibited extensive bone ingrowth (up to 80% in cortical sites) with minimal fibrous tissue and increasing pushout force over time.
Validation· Animal experimentation (ovine model) with quantitative histomorphometry and mechanical pushout tests.

通讯: Pin Wen @ Hubei Key Laboratory of Theory and Application of Advanced Materials Mechanics, School of Science, Wuhan University of T  |  Fei Chen @ State Key Laboratory of Advanced Technology for Materials Synthesis and Processing, Wuhan University of Technology, Wuha
相关性: 该论文研究了Al-Si10-Mg gyroid结构的力学性能，但材料非生物医用，且未涉及应力遮挡或骨整合。
边界: Uses Al-Si10-Mg alloy (not biocompatible Ti or CoCr), no fatigue testing, no osseointegration or surface roughness analysis for biomedical implants.
动机· 探究水平集值对gyroid结构力学性能的影响
方法· 通过SLM制备不同水平集值的gyroid试样，结合Micro-CT和压缩实验分析
结果· 水平集值显著影响弹性模量、平台应力和能量吸收能力

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To understand the effect of level-set values on the mechanical behavior of gyroid structures fabricated by SLM.
Method· Al-Si10-Mg gyroid surfaces with three level-set values were fabricated via SLM, characterized by Micro-CT, and tested under compression with numerical simulation.
Result· Level-set value significantly influences Young's modulus, plateau stress, densification strain, and energy absorption capacity.
Validation· Experimental compression tests combined with Micro-CT reconstruction and Gibson-Ashby model fitting.

Benedikt Adelmann, Melanie Abb, Ralf Hellmann IOP Conference Series Materials Science and Engineering 2021-11-01 10.1088/1757-899x/1135/1/012028
单位: Applied laser and photonics group, University of Applied Sciences Aschaffenburg, Wuerzburger Straße 45, 63739 Aschaffenburg, Germany
通讯: Benedikt Adelmann @ Applied laser and photonics group, University of Applied Sciences Aschaffenburg, Wuerzburger Straße 45, 63739 Aschaffenb
相关性: 该论文研究了SLM制造钛合金表面后处理对细胞生长的影响，但没有涉及力学测试或应力屏蔽分析。
边界: No mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no stress shielding quantification, and no lattice structures were tested.
动机· 研究SLM钛合金表面后处理对细胞生长的影响，以优化脊柱植入物的生物相容性。
方法· 通过SLM制造Ti-6Al-4V，采用铣削、热等静压、化学处理等后处理，培养人成纤维细胞并观察。
结果· 铣削路径间距小于0.18 mm时细胞生长良好，但铣削路径边缘会阻碍细胞生长。
验证· 体外细胞培养实验，结合荧光和扫描电镜成像。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To investigate how different surface post-processing steps on SLM-fabricated Ti-6Al-4V affect cell growth for spinal implant applications.
Method· Ti-6Al-4V samples were fabricated by selective laser melting and subjected to combinations of milling, hot isostatic pressing, chemical treatment, and steam sterilization. Human primary fibroblasts were cultured on the surfaces and cell growth and adhesion were analyzed.
Result· Good cell growth was observed for milling path spacings under 0.18 mm, while the edges of milling paths hindered cell proliferation.
Validation· In vitro cell culture experiments with fluorescence and scanning electron microscopy were used to assess cell behavior.

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Direct Skim only mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Abdullah Al Masud, Amit M. E. Arefin, Ming‐Chien Chyu, Paul Egan 2021-11-01 10.1115/imece2021-73745
单位: Texas Tech University, Lubbock, Texas, United States
通讯: Abdullah Al Masud @ Texas Tech University, Lubbock, Texas, United States
相关性: 该论文研究了通过调整单元胞高度实现多方向刚度调谐的3D打印支架，与应力屏蔽和刚度匹配相关，但缺乏LPBF制造、疲劳测试和表面形貌分析。
边界: No LPBF fabrication, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration analysis.
动机· 设计多方向刚度可调的骨组织支架以减少应力屏蔽。
方法· 采用SLA工艺打印不同高度的BC-Tetra单元胞晶格，进行压缩实验。
结果· 纵向弹性模量随单元胞高度增加而增加，横向模量降低。
验证· 通过单轴压缩实验验证力学性能。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To design bone tissue scaffolds with directionally tunable stiffness to mitigate stress shielding under complex loading.
Method· BC-Tetra unit cell lattices with adjustable height were fabricated via stereolithography and tested under compression.
Result· Longitudinal elastic modulus increased with unit cell height while transverse modulus decreased, enabling multi-directional stiffness tailoring.
Validation· Mechanical compression experiments validated the relationship between unit cell geometry and directional stiffness.

动机· 制造可降解骨支架以治疗大段骨缺损

Motivation· To fabricate biocompatible and biodegradable porous bone scaffolds for treating large osseous fractures.
Method· Triply periodic minimal surface (TPMS) scaffolds made of polycaprolactone (PCL) were fabricated via pneumatic micro-extrusion and characterized through a designed experiment.
Result· Diamond and Icosahedron TPMS designs yielded scaffolds with relatively high compression moduli.
Validation· Compressive properties were measured using a compression testing machine.

On Additive Manufacturing of Rib Fracture Fixation Implants: The Role of Lattice Design

Medium AM Biomedical Materials openalex Direct Save for project mechanical_testing Exp. validation
Lauren Judkins, Richa Gupta, Christine M. Gabriele, Charles Tomonto, Michael W. Hast et al. 2021-11-01 10.1115/imece2021-73086
单位: Pennsylvania State University, University Park, Pennsylvania, United States
通讯: Lauren Judkins @ Pennsylvania State University, University Park, Pennsylvania, United States
相关性: 该论文研究了通过LPBF制造的BCC点阵结构肋骨固定板的弯曲刚度调控，与用户关注的AM生物医学植入物刚度匹配和力学测试方向直接相关。
边界: This paper does not cover fatigue testing, surface roughness, as-built morphology, or osseointegration, and only addresses static flexural stiffness without linking to stress shielding or bone-implant interface mechanics.
动机· 现有肋骨固定板刚度过高，需设计可变刚度点阵结构以匹配肋骨力学性能。
方法· 设计不同孔隙率BCC点阵板，通过LPBF制造并进行四点弯曲测试。
结果· 减小支柱厚度和增大单元尺寸可降低刚度15.7%，为梯度点阵板设计提供指导。
验证· 四点弯曲力学测试验证刚度变化趋势。
英文摘要与术语
Motivation· Current rib fracture fixation implants are overly stiff, necessitating lattice designs with tunable stiffness to better match native rib mechanics.
Method· BCC lattice plates with varying porosity (36–86%) were designed by altering strut thickness and unit cell length, fabricated via LPBF, and tested under four-point bending.
Result· Decreasing strut thickness from 0.425 to 0.225 mm and increasing unit cell length from 1 to 3 mm reduced bending stiffness by 15.7% (p=0.068).
Validation· Four-point bending mechanical testing was used to characterize stiffness and strength changes.

边界: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis, no surface roughness or osseointegration data.
动机· 利用TPMS设计具有孔隙梯度的骨组织支架，以模拟松质骨到密质骨的过渡。
方法· 采用参数化方程精确表示TPMS基本单元，通过变化常数生成孔隙梯度。

Motivation· To design bone tissue scaffolds with a porosity gradient mimicking the transition from cancellous to cortical bone using triply periodic minimal surfaces (TPMS).
Method· Parametric equations are used to represent exact fundamental patches of TPMS, enabling controlled porosity gradients via a variation constant.
Result· The parametric approach preserves minimal curvature better than implicit equations, and 3D printed scaffold examples are presented.
Validation· No experimental validation; only 3D printed design examples are shown.

相关性: 该论文直接针对多孔Ti-6Al-4V合金结构设计以匹配皮质骨弹性模量，但仅进行了有限元模拟，缺乏LPBF制造和实验验证。
边界: This paper only performs finite element simulation without LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing, fatigue analysis, or surface characterization.
动机· 多孔钛合金植入物弹性模量与皮质骨不匹配导致应力遮挡
方法· 设计10%-70%孔隙率的多孔Ti-6Al-4V结构并进行有限元模拟
结果· 45%孔隙率样品弹性模量74GPa，最接近皮质骨，可减少应力遮挡

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· The mismatch in elastic modulus between dense Ti-6Al-4V implants and cortical bone causes stress shielding, leading to implant failure.
Method· Porous Ti-6Al-4V structures with porosities from 10% to 70% were designed and simulated using finite element analysis to determine the optimal elastic modulus.
Result· The structure with 45% porosity exhibited an elastic modulus of 74 GPa, closely matching cortical bone and reducing stress shielding.
Validation· Validation was limited to simulation; no experimental fabrication or mechanical testing was performed.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To compare bone density changes and initial implant stability after sinus augmentation using autograft versus fresh frozen allograft in a clinical setting.
Method· A prospective, randomized, split-mouth study was conducted on 15 patients who underwent bilateral sinus augmentation with autogenous or fresh frozen bone, followed by dental implant placement after six months.
Result· Both grafts showed increased bone density over time; insertion torque was significantly higher in the fresh frozen bone group, supporting its reliability as a graft material.
Validation· Validation was performed through a randomized clinical trial with CBCT imaging at three time points and intraoperative torque measurements.

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate bacterial adhesion on different zirconia surface textures for dental implant applications, addressing the knowledge gap in microorganism accumulation on zirconia architectures.
Method· Co-culture adhesion assays of Escherichia coli, Staphylococcus aureus, and Pseudomonas aeruginosa were performed on various textured zirconia surfaces and compared with a titanium control.
Result· E. coli showed higher adhesion on channelled zirconia, while S. aureus and P. aeruginosa adhered more to titanium; co-culture revealed significant differences in bacterial behavior.
Validation· In vitro bacterial adhesion experiments with CFU enumeration validated surface-dependent adhesion propensities.

Motivation· To enhance the osseointegration of zirconia dental implants by modifying the inert surface.
Method· A TiO2 coating was prepared on zirconia via immersion in a mixed ZrOCl2 and TiO2 suspension, followed by surface characterization, mechanical tests, and in vitro cell assays.

Motivation· To develop a dual-delivery system for sequential release of substance P and alendronate to enhance immediate implant osseointegration.

Motivation· To develop biodegradable zinc matrix composites with enhanced mechanical properties and controllable degradation for orthopedic implants.

动机· 评估PENG阻滞在髋关节置换术后的镇痛效果和早期活动能力。

英文摘要与术语
Motivation· To evaluate the clinical effectiveness of Pericapsular Nerve Group block for postoperative analgesia and early mobilization after total hip arthroplasty.
Method· A prospective study of 30 patients receiving PENG block with 30 ml 0.25% bupivacaine after primary THA under spinal anesthesia, assessing pain scores, opioid consumption, and walking ability.
Result· The PENG block provided adequate analgesia with 77% of patients reporting mild pain, 36% requiring no opioids on surgery day, and all patients able to walk 30 meters by postoperative day two.
Validation· Clinical observation in 30 patients without a control group.

Motivation· To quantify the diagnostic sensitivity of D-dimer, ESR, and CRP for acute periprosthetic joint infection (PJI) in a large cohort.
Method· A retrospective review of 961 PJI patients from an institutional database, with sensitivity analysis of biomarkers using standard cutoff values.
Result· D-dimer showed the highest sensitivity (91.9%), while CRP and ESR had comparable sensitivities (66.7% and 61.3% respectively).
Validation· Clinical cohort study with retrospective data collection and sensitivity calculation.
